summary.answer: The conditional HMH producer-to-consumer connection is now pinned: init_heal creates the exact enabled/rate/delay-mode/cap fields only when the table is absent; the value setter and gadget write enabled, the gadget builds rate/cap, and healthoverlay consumes them. Stored rate0 selects a default-rate path when enabled, while enabled0 blocks the ordinary rate path. The separate var_44d52546 force branch bypasses that rate block but still follows delay/cap/tick admission. Stored cap0 means use var_66cb03ad, including after exempt damage drains the stored cap to0. Spawn and completion reset only their shown fields; no guaranteed automatic re-enable on revive is established. These are recovered-source conditions, not effective HMH settings or original PS4 behavior.
